findings.explanation: The 7 and 23.9 basis points are abnormal returns: the intercept of a regression against a value-weighted Taiwan market index (barber-odean L452-L458), weighted by the money invested. "They lost 7 basis points a day" reads as a raw loss on their accounts; it is a shortfall relative to simply holding the market.
findings.suggestion: Say "Taken as a group, they trailed the market by 7 basis points a day before costs, ... and trading costs more than tripled that shortfall, to 23.9."
